page.overview:
Who is Bear Robot?

The bear robot was a device created by Jonathan Frink as a potential replacement for Bobo for Charles Montgomery Burns. It was supposed to hug Burns and perform a dance. However, something was lost in translation for the programming, as the robot instead grabbed Burns and jerked him around painfully and awkwardly. It then walked into a wall, destroying it.
